page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5ge.24xlarge is an x86_64 storage-optimized instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 3.2 GHz Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor providing 96 dedicated vCPUs. System memory totals 576.0 GB RAM, delivering an allocation ratio of 6.0 GB of memory per core without discrete GPU acceleration.

The primary differentiator of this instance is its direct storage and interconnect configuration. It integrates 15,358 GB of bundled local SSD capacity alongside a 172 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile. This hardware combination prioritizes high local I/O throughput and low-latency disk interaction paired with massive network ingress and egress capacity.

Because it consolidates 96 dedicated compute cores, 576.0 GB of memory, and over 15 TB of integrated SSD storage within a single instance, it provides dense physical resource aggregation. A notable operational tradeoff is the nature of local storage, which requires application-level data redundancy and replication strategies to protect against instance termination or node-level events.

The ecs.i5ge.24xlarge instance is suited for storage-intensive and I/O-bound enterprise workloads. Target applications include large-scale distributed databases, NoSQL clusters such as Cassandra or MongoDB, in-memory caches requiring persistent local backing, search index processing, and distributed analytical data stores.
